about: Where job-weekly finds growing companies most applicants miss. Each source is read as information (web search or one page fetch, robots permitting); companies found go into the job list's hidden table through hidden.py add. 'query' entries are web searches with {industry}, {place} and {year} filled in.

sources.name: Funding news
sources.extract: company, amount, round, date: a round in the last 6 months usually means hiring

sources.name: Enterprise Ireland start-up directory
sources.extract: the companies Enterprise Ireland backed (High Potential Start-Ups), with sectors

sources.name: Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Ireland)
sources.extract: the fastest-growing Irish tech companies (winners and category lists)

sources.name: Deloitte EMEA Technology Fast 500
sources.extract: the companies from the person's country

sources.name: FT 1000: Europe's fastest-growing companies
sources.extract: companies in the person's country and fields

sources.name: Sunday Times 100
sources.extract: UK companies in the person's fields

sources.name: VC portfolios
sources.extract: portfolio companies of local investors (job-scout already reads portfolio job boards)

sources.name: Y Combinator companies
sources.extract: companies hiring in the person's region and fields

sources.name: Conference exhibitors and sponsors
sources.extract: exhibitor and sponsor lists: companies spending to be seen are usually growing

sources.name: Alternatives to the big names
sources.extract: competitors of the well-known companies the person targets (G2 categories, 'alternatives to' lists)

sources.name: Own-site postings
sources.extract: companies whose roles are only on their own hiring system; run on the person's computer (the daily connection queue task, Mondays), since web search ignores site:
